errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the line styles in the legend. The legend shows six distinct styles (solid, short-dashed, medium-dashed, long-dashed, and two types of dash-dot lines), but the description reduces them to only three categories.
The description incorrectly states that the middle line in the left plot starts at around 1700 in 2004. The actual value for this line (dash-dot line) in 2004 is approximately 400.
The description incorrectly states that the top line in the right plot starts at around 1100-1200 in 2004. The actual value for this line (medium-dashed line) in 2004 is approximately 400.
The description incorrectly states that the middle line in the right plot starts at around 500-700 in 2004. The actual value for this line (dash-dot line) in 2004 is approximately 400.

In the left plot, the middle line is indeed dash-dot. However, its starting value is described as ~1700, which belongs to no line. The description is hallucinating a connection between a line style and an incorrect value.
